actions.createPhoneCall.description: Create a phone call to customer from Agent
actions.createPhoneCall.props.details.de: Optional details with key-value pairs (e.g., customer_id, priority)
actions.createPhoneCall.props.phoneNumbe: Enter the phone number, along with country code, in format (e.g., +919876543210)
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.getCallDetails.description: Fetch Call details by Call ID
actions.getCallTranscript.description: Fetch the transcript of a call by Call ID
actions.gmailGetListOfAgents.description: get the lists of agents with Gmail
actions.scheduleCallAgent.description: Schedule a call with an agent
actions.scheduleCallAgent.props.executio: Time to schedule the call in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
actions.scheduleCallAgent.props.prospect: Optional prospect details with key-value pairs (e.g., customer_id, priority)
actions.scheduleCallAgent.props.timezone: Timezone of the scheduled call (e.g., Asia/Calcutta)
auth.description:
To obtain your AiAnswer API access token, follow these steps below:
      1. Log in to your AiAnswer account at https://app.aianswer.us .
      2. Navigate to Settings < API Key.
      3. Click on Copy icon to copy your existing Key or click on New API Key to create a new one.
      4. Copy the API Key and paste it below in "AiAnswer API Key".
